text: No one has a better religion than one who submits with his heart and all his limbs to Allah alone, while being righteous, and follows the religion of Ibrahim and his law, turning away from corrupt beliefs and false legislations. And Allah has chosen Ibrahim - peace be upon him - and taken him as a close friend (khalil) from among all His creation. In this verse, the attribute of khulla (close friendship) is affirmed for Allah - exalted is He - which is the highest rank of love and selection.
